name: acme-mail
description: Mail and contacts of the Acme team, straight from Claude.
long_description: A branded build of Stalwart Mail MCP: the server address is pre-filled, tools are called acme_*, and people only type their e-mail and password.

tools.name: acme_list_mailboxes
tools.description: Accounts, folders with message counts and allowed senders

tools.name: acme_search_emails
tools.description: Search messages (full text, from/to, subject, folder, date, unread) and list a thread

tools.name: acme_get_email
tools.description: A whole message by id with its text and the list of attachments

tools.name: acme_get_attachment
tools.description: Open an attachment: text of PDFs and text files, OCR of scans and photographed documents, images, saved to disk

tools.name: acme_send_email
tools.description: Send a new e-mail or a reply in a thread, with attachments from disk

tools.name: acme_create_draft
tools.description: Save a message as a draft for review in webmail

tools.name: acme_search_contacts
tools.description: Find addresses in the address books (own and shared) and in the mail history

tools.name: acme_add_contact
tools.description: Create a contact in an address book (shared ones too)

email.title: Mailbox e-mail
email.description: The full address you sign in with, e.g. jane@example.com.

password.title: Mailbox password
password.description: The mailbox password (or an app password). Stored in the operating system's keychain.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of tool descriptions and output: auto (follow the system), en, cs, de, es, fr, it, nl, pl, pt, sk.

mistral_api_key.title: Mistral API key (OCR, simplest setup)
mistral_api_key.description: Optional. Fill in just this and scans are read through Mistral OCR. For another provider or a local model use the OCR settings below instead.

server_url.title: Server address
server_url.description: Leave the default unless you know why to change it.

allow_send.title: Allow sending
allow_send.description: Off = Claude cannot send mail at all (the send tools are not offered); it can still prepare drafts.

allow_drafts.title: Allow drafts
allow_drafts.description: Off = Claude cannot create or delete drafts.

allow_contact_edit.title: Allow adding contacts
allow_contact_edit.description: Off = Claude can look contacts up but not add them.

allow_attachments.title: Allow opening attachments
allow_attachments.description: Off = Claude sees attachment names only and cannot read their content.

save_attachments.title: Keep opened attachments on disk
save_attachments.description: On = every attachment Claude opens is also saved to the download folder. Off = it is only read and nothing is written to disk, which makes the attachment tool read-only.

ocr_provider.title: OCR provider
ocr_provider.description: Who reads scans and photographed documents: auto (Mistral when its key below is filled in), off, mistral, anthropic, openai, openrouter, gemini, ollama, lmstudio, or custom (any OpenAI-compatible server; give its address).

ocr_api_key.title: OCR API key
ocr_api_key.description: API key of the chosen OCR provider. Not needed for local servers (Ollama, LM Studio).

ocr_model.title: OCR model
ocr_model.description: Model to use, e.g. a vision model you run in Ollama or one offered by your API provider. Empty = the provider's default where there is one (Mistral, Anthropic).

ocr_base_url.title: OCR server address
ocr_base_url.description: Only for a custom or non-default server, e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1. Empty = the provider's standard address.
